headline: In a backtest it may have seen in training, Chronos-2 had clearly less cost-weighted error than a weather regression over all half-hours at each tested cost ratio from 0.5 to 10, and, in the size of the daily peak on the coldest tenth of days, not clearly different where a shortfall cost 0.5 to 1.5 times a surplus, and clearly more from 2 to 10.
break_even_sentence: Over all half-hours, there was no break-even ratio above 0 (Chronos-2 better at every ratio above 0; 96% of bootstrap draws in this case); at cold-day peaks, the break-even ratio was 0.69 (Chronos-2 better below it and worse above; 100% of bootstrap draws in this case; conditional 90% interval 0.38 to 1.53).
